amount.description: Minor units; at least the country minimum withdrawal.

account_number.description: Pay-TV and bills: the smartcard, IUC or meter number.

transaction_type.description: Pay-TV: change to this package, or renew it as the current package.

face_value.description: Face value in minor units of the product face currency: one of its fixed values, or within its range.

quantity.description: More than 1 for gift cards only.

status.description: Enable an endpoint again after fixing it, or pause it.

routing.description: `preferred`: used before BitoCard’s suppliers; `fallback`: only when BitoCard has no offer; `off`: never.

tax.description: Tax BitoCard collects as seller of record, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo).

charged.description: Taken from your wallet: wholesale plus tax, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo).

price.description: Price your customer pays, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo).

reseller_profit.description: Your profit, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo).

customer_reference.description: Your own reference for the customer, as given on the quote.

Error.title: Error
Error.description: Every error has this shape. `param` is present only when the error is about one field.

code.description: A stable, machine-readable code, for example `insufficient_funds` or `quote_expired`. Branch on this, not on the message.

message.description: What went wrong, in plain English. Safe to show to your staff; never includes internal details.

param.description: The request field the error is about (for example `quantity` or `recipient.phone`). Only present when there is one.

country.description: Business country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Null until it is set; it cannot be changed afterwards.

status.description: `pending` until the owner passes the identity check (and, where required, BitoCard approves the account), then `active`; `suspended` if BitoCard has suspended it.

Account.title: Account
Account.description: The reseller account a request acts for, its plan, and how the request was authenticated.

amount.description: Monthly price in US cents, charged from your wallet in your currency. 0 for the free plan.

currency.description: Always `USD`.

features.description: What the plan adds, for example `chargeback_protection`.

authenticated_as.description: How this request was authenticated: an API key, a documentation "Try it" token, or a signed-in person (dashboard session).

oneOf.description: A short-lived token issued to a signed-in person by the documentation’s "Try it" feature.

expires_at.description: When the token stops working (15 minutes after it was issued).

role.description: Their role in this reseller account.

ResellerVerification.title: Reseller identity check
ResellerVerification.description: The business owner’s identity check (ID document and face check), needed before the account goes live.

reseller_status.description: `pending` until the owner passes the identity check (and, where required, BitoCard approves the account), then `active`; `suspended` if BitoCard has suspended it.

verified.description: Whether the business owner’s identity is verified.

status.description: `not_started`, `in_progress` (waiting for the person to finish at `url`), `in_review` (BitoCard is reviewing it), `approved`, `declined` or `expired` (not finished within 7 days).

url.description: The page where the owner photographs an ID document and takes a selfie, while the check is `in_progress`; otherwise null.

reason.description: Why the check did not pass: `name_mismatch` (the record has a different name), `bvn_consent_declined`, `not_verified` (declined for another reason) or `expired`. Null otherwise.

started_at.description: When the latest check started; null if none has.

BvnCheck.title: BVN check
BvnCheck.description: Nigeria: the business owner’s BVN check, needed before reserved bank accounts are opened. The BVN itself is never returned.

verified.description: Whether the owner’s BVN is verified.

status.description: `not_started`, `in_progress` (waiting for the person to finish at `url`), `in_review` (BitoCard is reviewing it), `approved`, `declined` or `expired` (not finished within 7 days).

url.description: The bank’s consent page where the owner approves sharing their BVN record, while the check is `in_progress`; otherwise null.

reason.description: Why the check did not pass: `name_mismatch` (the record has a different name), `bvn_consent_declined`, `not_verified` (declined for another reason) or `expired`. Null otherwise.

started_at.description: When the latest check started; null if none has.

Country.title: Country
Country.description: A market: its currency, the product categories sold there and the money rules its resellers work under.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency resellers here trade in.

reseller_signup.description: Whether resellers based here can sign up.

reserved_accounts.description: Whether reserved bank accounts (wallet top-ups by bank transfer) are offered here.

markup_cap_percent.description: Markup Protection Scheme: the most your price may be above BitoCard’s wholesale price, in percent.

payout_hold_days.description: Days before a sale’s profit can be withdrawn.

min_withdrawal_minor.description: Smallest withdrawal, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo).

customer_verification.description: Whether hosted storefront customers must verify their identity to buy it here.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description: Your choices within what BitoCard allows in your country, and the features switched on for you.

options.description: Each option: the value in effect, what your country allows, and where the value comes from.

gift_card_payout.description: Where customers receive money from gift cards they sell.

value.description: The value in effect: your choice if your country still allows it, otherwise your country’s default. Null if the option is not available in your country yet.

allowed.description: The values your country allows; empty if none yet.

fixed_price_earning.description: How resellers earn on face-value products: a markup on top, or selling at face value and keeping BitoCard's discount.

value.description: The value in effect: your choice if your country still allows it, otherwise your country’s default. Null if the option is not available in your country yet.

allowed.description: The values your country allows; empty if none yet.

features.description: Features BitoCard has switched on (`true`) or off for your account. Off unless switched on.

welcome_bonus.description: The $1 customer welcome bonus; only ever per reseller.

reserved_accounts.description: Live reserved bank accounts (top-ups by bank transfer), on top of the country offering them. In Nigeria the owner also needs a verified BVN.

own_integrations.description: Resellers connect their own supplier and payment gateway accounts (on plans with own integrations, for integrations offered in their country).

customer_app_bottom_bar_desktop.description: Customers' account app uses the bottom tab bar on desktop too, instead of the side rail. A reseller's own choice for their store (SHQ Store) wins over this.

manual_reseller_approval.description: Resellers who pass the identity check wait for an admin to activate them, instead of going live at once.

Invitation.title: Invitation
Invitation.description: A pending invitation to join your team.

expires_at.description: When the invitation link stops working (7 days after it was sent).

Team.title: Team
Team.description: Your team: members and pending invitations.

role.description: `owner` (one per account; cannot be changed or removed), `admin` (team and keys), `developer` (keys and webhooks), `finance` or `support`.

members.description: Members, in the order they joined.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: A product you can sell, with your wholesale cost and your price. Suppliers, their costs and routing are never shown.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country where the product is used: the card region, or the network or biller country.

face_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the face values.

denomination.description: The face values on offer: a list of fixed values, or a range the customer chooses within. In minor units of `face_currency`.

items.description: A face value, in minor units of `face_currency`.

min.description: Lowest face value, in minor units of `face_currency`.

max.description: Highest face value, in minor units of `face_currency`.

recipient_type.description: What the quote needs about the customer: `phone` (airtime and data: `recipient.phone`), `smartcard` (pay-TV) or `meter` (electricity: `recipient.account_number`), or `none` (gift cards, software and the like).

redeem_instructions.description: How the customer redeems it, where it applies.

logo_url.description: The product logo from BitoCard files: the product image, else the brand logo; or null. Show it on a white tile.

features.description: What the product can do, for example `sms_in` (receives SMS) or `app_codes` (receives sign-in codes from apps) on a virtual number. Empty for most products.

image_url.description: A picture for the product: its own image, else its brand’s gift card design.

listed.description: Listed on your BitoCard-hosted store. Your own systems can sell any product in your catalogue, listed or not.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the prices: your wallet currency.

face_value.description: Face value, in minor units of `face_currency`.

wholesale.description: Your wholesale cost for one item, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

price.description: Your price to your customer for one item, with your markup, before any tax added at checkout, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

denominations.description: Prices per face value (at most 20; for a range, its lowest and highest). A quote locks the exact price for any valid value.

listed.description: Whether the products are now listed (true) or unlisted (false) on your hosted store.

product_ids.description: The products you sent, without repeats.

updated.description: How many changed: products newly listed, or listings removed. Products already in that state are not counted.

Pricing.title: Pricing
Pricing.description: How you price: your markups, the cap on them, and how you earn on face-value products.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency you sell in.

earning.description: How you earn on face-value products (airtime, data, pay-TV and bills in your currency): `markup` (you sell above face value) or `discount` (you sell at face value and earn BitoCard’s discount). Set by your country’s options.

markup_cap_percent.description: The Markup Protection Scheme cap: your price can be at most this percentage above wholesale price.

category.description: The category the markup applies to.

product_id.description: The product, for a product markup (which overrides its category’s); null for the whole category.

product_name.description: The product’s name, for a product markup.

markup_bps.description: Markup over wholesale price in basis points (1500 = 15%).

markups.description: Your markups. Categories and products without one sell at wholesale price (face value for face-value products).

Quote.title: Quote
Quote.description: A locked price for one purchase: face value, quantity, your wholesale cost, your price, tax and the exchange rate, held for 10 minutes.

id.description: Quote ID. Place the order with it (`POST /v1/orders`).

status.description: `open` until used for an order (`used`) or past `expires_at` (`expired`).

face_value.description: Face value of one item, in minor units of `face_currency`.

face_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the face value.

quantity.description: Number of items (more than 1 for gift cards and software only).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the amounts below: your wallet currency.

wholesale.description: Your wholesale cost for the whole quantity: what the order takes from your wallet, plus `tax`, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

unit_wholesale.description: Your wholesale cost for one item, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

price.description: What your customer pays for the whole quantity, tax included, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

anyOf.description: Tax on the sale, where the category is taxed in your country.

amount.description: Tax included in `price`, which BitoCard collects and pays as seller of record, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

reseller_profit.description: Your profit: `price` less tax and wholesale, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

source.description: `bitocard`, or `own`: fulfilled through your own supplier account, where BitoCard charges only its fee and adds no tax (you are the seller).

anyOf.description: For `own` quotes: your supplier account that will fulfil it.
For `own` quotes: BitoCard’s fee, taken from your wallet when the order completes.

rate_percent.description: BitoCard’s fee rate as an exact percentage string, for example `1.5`.

max.description: The most the fee can be; fractions of a minor unit are carried to your next order, never rounded up, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

recipient.description: Who receives it: `phone` for airtime and data; `account_number` (smartcard, IUC or meter) for pay-TV and bills, with the `account_name` the provider returned for the customer to confirm (and, for pay-TV, `current_package` and `transaction_type`); `email` for gift cards and software when you asked for the codes to be emailed to your customer. Null when the product needs no recipient.

customer_reference.description: Your own reference for the customer or sale, as you sent it.

expires_at.description: When the locked price expires (10 minutes after it was created).

OrderDetail.title: Order with deliveries

status.description: `processing` until the supplier confirms; then `completed` or `failed`. A completed order can later be `refunded`.

face_value.description: Face value of one item, in minor units of `face_currency`.

face_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the face value.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the amounts below (your wallet currency).

wholesale.description: Your wholesale cost, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo).

tax.description: Tax BitoCard collects as seller of record, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo).

charged.description: Taken from your wallet: wholesale plus tax, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo).

price.description: Price your customer pays, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo).

reseller_profit.description: Your profit, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo).

recipient.description: Who received it: `phone` for airtime and data, `account_number` (smartcard or meter) for pay-TV and bills.

customer_reference.description: Your own reference for the customer, as given on the quote.

source.description: `bitocard`, or `own`: fulfilled through your own supplier account (you are the seller; `charged` is only BitoCard’s fee).

integration.description: For `own` orders: your supplier account that fulfilled it.

failure_reason.description: Why the order failed, for failed orders.

updated_at.description: When the order last changed. Use it to ignore an older event that arrives after a newer one.

completed_at.description: When the order completed or failed.

kind.description: What was delivered: `gift_card` (code and often a PIN), `licence_key` (software key), `token` (electricity token in `code`), `confirmation` (airtime, data and pay-TV: nothing to hand over) or `virtual_number` (the number in `serial`).

code.description: The gift card code, licence key or electricity token. A secret: show it only to your customer.

pin.description: The gift card PIN, where it has one. A secret.

serial.description: A serial number, or the phone number for `virtual_number`.

details.description: More about the delivery, for example `units` for an electricity token, `redemption_url` and `expires_at` for some gift cards, `duration` for a software licence (for example `1 year` or `Lifetime`), or `number` and `number_type` for a virtual number.

deliveries.description: What was delivered: one item per gift card or licence (the quantity), or one confirmation. Empty while `processing` and for failed orders.

OrderDetail.description: An order as returned for one order (`POST /v1/orders`, `GET /v1/orders/{id}`): the order plus what was delivered. Codes, PINs and tokens appear only here, never in lists or webhooks.

Receipt.title: Receipt
Receipt.description: The customer receipt for a completed order. BitoCard (the Golojan entity for your region) is the seller of record; the receipt carries your store name.

number.description: Receipt number, the same as the order’s `receipt_number`.

seller.description: The seller of record: the Golojan entity for your region, with its registration number under its local label.

name.description: Legal name, for example `De-Golojan Technologies Ltd` (Africa), `Golojan Ltd` (UK and Europe) or `Golojan Technologies LLC` (elsewhere).

sold_through.description: Your store name (or business name), shown as the brand the customer bought through.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the amounts.

unit_price.description: Price of one item, tax included, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

amount.description: Line total, tax included, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

subtotal.description: Total before tax, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

amount.description: Tax, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

total.description: Total paid by the customer, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

customer_reference.description: Your own reference for the customer, as given on the quote.

Wallet.title: Wallet
Wallet.description: Your wallet in one mode. Live and sandbox wallets are separate; amounts are integer minor units of `currency`.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the amounts, your wallet currency (for example `NGN`, `GHS` or `KES`).

available.description: What you can spend on wholesale cost now: topped-up funds plus withdrawable earnings, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

reserved.description: Held for orders still in progress, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

withdrawable.description: Profit past the payout hold: can be withdrawn or spent (already included in `available`), in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

on_hold.description: Profit still inside the payout hold, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

next_release_at.description: When the next profit on hold becomes withdrawable; null when nothing is on hold.

payouts_in_progress.description: Withdrawals on their way to your bank, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

minimum_withdrawal.description: The smallest withdrawal allowed in your country, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

anyOf.description: The one-time startup allowance. It pays only the wholesale cost of customer-paid orders and is never cash: it is not part of `available` and cannot be withdrawn.

currency.description: Always `USD`.

granted.description: The allowance granted, in US cents (50000 = US$500).

remaining.description: What is left, in US cents.

status.description: `active` while some remains, `used` once spent, `revoked` when BitoCard took back what remained.

revoked_at.description: When it was revoked, if it was.

WalletTransaction.title: WalletTransaction
WalletTransaction.description: One movement of money in your wallet. Every movement is a balanced ledger entry and is never edited afterwards.

type.description: What happened: `top_up` (checkout payment), `deposit` (bank transfer into your reserved account), `hold` (wholesale cost held for an order, plan or fee), `hold_release` (a hold returned), `hold_capture` (a hold taken: order delivered or plan paid), `earnings` (sale profit, on hold), `earnings_release` (profit became withdrawable), `payout` (withdrawal set aside or paid), `payout_reversal` (failed withdrawal returned), `order_refund`, `platform_fee`, `platform_fee_refund`, `adjustment` (a correction by BitoCard), `allowance_granted` or `allowance_revoked` (the startup allowance).

description.description: A plain description, for example `Wallet top-up` or `Order delivered: MTN Nigeria airtime`.

currency.description: Currency of the changes below; `USD` for startup allowance entries. Null only if the entry touched none of your balances.

amount.description: Change to `available` (negative when money left it), in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

reserved_change.description: Change to `reserved`, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

earnings_on_hold_change.description: Change to earnings on hold, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

allowance_change.description: Change to the startup allowance, in US cents. Never part of `amount`.

fee.description: For `platform_fee`, `platform_fee_refund` and the hold returned before a fee: the BitoCard fee it belongs to. Null otherwise.

id.description: ID of the order or payment.

PaymentMethod.title: PaymentMethod
PaymentMethod.description: A way to pay that BitoCard offers in your market.

id.description: Pass it as `method` when topping up.

label.description: What payers see, for example `Card` or `Mobile money`.

ReservedAccount.title: ReservedAccount
ReservedAccount.description: A bank account reserved for your wallet: transfers into it top up the wallet once the bank confirms them.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the amounts, your wallet currency (for example `NGN`, `GHS` or `KES`).

account_number.description: The account number to transfer to. It belongs to your wallet only.

SimulatedDeposit.title: SimulatedDeposit
SimulatedDeposit.description: The result of a simulated bank transfer (sandbox only).

credited.description: Whether the wallet was credited (a `top_up.succeeded` event follows).

amount.description: The simulated transfer, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the amounts, your wallet currency (for example `NGN`, `GHS` or `KES`).

FeeCharge.title: FeeCharge
FeeCharge.description: BitoCard’s fee on one transaction through your own integrations. Fees are exact: the part below one minor unit is carried to your next fee, never rounded up.

kind.description: `supplier_order` (an order through your own supplier) or `gateway_payment` (a payment through your own gateway).

status.description: `held` (the most it can be is held from your wallet), `charged`, `released` (the transaction failed: nothing charged) or `refunded`.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the amounts, your wallet currency (for example `NGN`, `GHS` or `KES`).

id.description: ID of the order or payment.

anyOf.description: Product category of the order; null for gateway payments.

rate_ppb.description: The rate in parts per billion of the base: 1 is 0.0000001%, 1,000,000 is 0.1%, 100,000,000 (the highest) is 10%.

rate_percent.description: The same rate as an exact percentage, for example `0.25`.

base.description: What the rate applies to (the order cost or face value, or the payment), in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

min_fee.description: The minimum fee per transaction, in minor units of `currency`, if the rate has one.

exact_nano.description: The exact fee: `base` x `rate_ppb`, never rounded. In billionths of a minor unit, as a string of digits so no precision is lost.

held.description: Held from your wallet before the transaction: the exact fee rounded up, or the minimum fee, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

charged.description: What was charged, in minor units of `currency`: whole units of the carried fraction plus the exact fee. Null until charged.

carry_before_nano.description: Your carried fraction before this charge. Null until charged. In billionths of a minor unit, as a string of digits.

carry_after_nano.description: The fraction left over after this charge, carried to your next fee (always below one minor unit). Null until charged. In billionths of a minor unit, as a string of digits.

settled_at.description: When it was charged or released.

FeeStatement.title: FeeStatement
FeeStatement.description: What BitoCard charged you in one month: fees and plan charges.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the amounts, your wallet currency (for example `NGN`, `GHS` or `KES`).

fees.description: BitoCard fees on your own-integration transactions.

transactions.description: Fees charged in the month (including those later refunded).

charged.description: Total charged, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

refunded.description: Total refunded, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

net.description: Charged less refunded, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

base.description: Total base of those fees, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

charged.description: Charged, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

refunded.description: Refunded, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

by_kind.description: The same totals per fee kind.

subscription.description: Plan charges paid in the month, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

total.description: Net fees plus plan charges, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo or cents).

carried_nano.description: The fraction accrued but not yet charged, now (always below one minor unit). In billionths of a minor unit, as a string of digits so no precision is lost.

FeeRate.title: FeeRate
FeeRate.description: A BitoCard fee rate that applies to you now, for your country and plan. Zero means no fee.

anyOf.description: Product category; null for any category without its own rate (and always for gateway payments).

rate_ppb.description: The rate in parts per billion of the base: 1 is 0.0000001%, 1,000,000 is 0.1%, 100,000,000 (the highest) is 10%.

rate_percent.description: The same rate as an exact percentage, for example `0.25`.

min_fee.description: The minimum fee per transaction, in minor units of `currency`, if any.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of `min_fee`: the currency of your country, which is your wallet currency. Null only before your business country is set.

ExchangeRate.title: ExchangeRate
ExchangeRate.description: BitoCard’s rate between the US dollar and one currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency.

available.description: False while conversions are paused (stale or disagreeing reference rates): quotes and plan charges needing this currency are refused.

pay.description: Units of the currency charged per US dollar, margin included: used when you pay in this currency for a US dollar amount. A decimal string (up to 6 places); null when unavailable.

receive.description: Units of the currency received per US dollar, margin deducted: used when US dollars are converted into this currency. A decimal string (up to 6 places); null when unavailable.

margin_percent.description: BitoCard’s disclosed conversion margin, in percent.

as_of.description: When the oldest rate used was fetched; null when unavailable.

Bank.title: Bank
Bank.description: A bank you can be paid out to.

name.description: Bank or mobile money service name.

BankAccount.title: BankAccount
BankAccount.description: A bank account your earnings are paid out to. The bank confirms the account and supplies its name.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the account.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the amounts, your wallet currency (for example `NGN`, `GHS` or `KES`).

bank_code.description: Bank code from the bank list.

account_number_last4.description: Last four digits of the account number; the full number is never shown again.

account_name.description: The account holder’s name, as the bank has it.

payouts_available_from.description: When payouts to it can start: 24 hours after a live account is added; at once in the sandbox.

PayoutDetail.title: Payout with its bank account
PayoutDetail.description: A withdrawal of your earnings to a bank account.

status.description: `pending` while it starts, `processing` while the bank transfer is on its way, then `paid` or `failed`.

amount.description: Amount withdrawn, in minor units of `currency` (for example kobo).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency.

failure_reason.description: Why the transfer failed, for failed payouts.

completed_at.description: When it was paid or failed.

bank_account.description: The account paid. Webhook payloads leave this out.

account_number_last4.description: Last four digits of the account number.

removed.description: Whether the account has since been removed (the payout still names it).

amount.description: Monthly price in US cents (0 for Standard). Charged in your currency at the `pay` rate when billed.

currency.description: Always `USD`.

renews_at.description: When the plan is next charged; null when it is not billed (Standard, or a plan set by BitoCard).

cancel_at_period_end.description: True when the plan ends at the end of the paid month instead of renewing.

past_due_since.description: When a renewal failed for lack of funds; the plan stays on for a grace period of 7 days.

ApiKey.title: API key
ApiKey.description: A secret key for your own systems. Only its prefix is ever shown after it is created.

name.description: The name you gave the key, such as the system that uses it.

mode.description: `test` keys use the sandbox (simulated fulfilment, no real money); `live` keys move real money.

prefix.description: The first characters of the secret (for example `bc_live_a1b2c3`), so you can tell keys apart. The full secret is never shown again.

last_used_at.description: When the key last authenticated a request; null if never used.

expires_at.description: When the key stops working: set when the key is rolled and the old secret keeps working for the overlap. Null if it does not expire.

revoked_at.description: When the key was revoked; null while it is active.

CreatedApiKey.title: API key with its secret
CreatedApiKey.description: A newly created or rolled key, with its secret. The secret is never shown again.

Fires once when the bank refuses or fails the transfer. The amount is back in your withdrawable earnings.

Does not fire while the outcome is unclear: BitoCard keeps checking with the bank.

Comes after you request the payout. Nothing follows it.

Fires once when a customer check you started (`POST /v1/customers/{reference}/verification`) passes: the BVN record released with the customer’s consent matches their name, or their ID document and face check passed.

Does not fire while the customer has not finished the check, or for checks still in review.

Comes after you start the check. Nothing follows it.

post.description:
Fires once when a customer check fails: the name on the BVN record differs, the customer refused consent, or the document or face check failed. `reason` says which.

Does not fire for checks that simply expire unfinished (the check shows `expired` when you get it).

Comes after you start the check. You can start a new check for the same customer afterwards.
